critical_code_review_comments: Filter at server.py:5169-5171 only handles dict-shaped vessels. The branch above at 5172 (`hasattr(vessel, 'river_mile')`) handles object-shaped vessels but does NOT apply the same is_simulated/is_user_vessel skip — if the in-memory store ever stores Vessel pydantic models with these flags, the filter would be bypassed. Consider adding the same check for the object branch for completeness.
Lock Timing / race-analysis appears to use a different competitor-detection path; the new filter should be replicated there to fully eliminate self-as-threat for that card.

rca_of_the_issue: Previous self-as-threat bug: backend trip-plan loop iterated active_vessels and only skipped exact session_mmsi match. When TWO user-vessel simulations were enabled (e.g. tester A and tester B both at the same RM/heading), each appeared in the other's threat-detection with absurd required_speed_mph (e.g. 981.3). Fix at server.py:5169-5171 skips any vessel with both is_simulated=True and is_user_vessel=True. Demo vessels (is_demo=True, is_simulated absent) are unaffected and still surface as threats.
